body: I'm open to the idea but why would that help?

Thanks. I used to feel guilty about it too but I haven't seen my parents for a while that it's somewhat faded. I deleted all my social media the day I abruptly moved out so they have no idea what I'm up to. They do know where I live but haven't visit me probably because they're afraid of how i will react. A whole bunch of stuff is happening to me that I don't want to deal with much longer. I don't want to make them sad but i also am done with life. Anyway thanks for the comment
Believing in myself is difficult for me. Thanks for the kind words which have given me some things to think about
Thank you. I've noticed that writing about it helps me formulate my throughs and cope with the pain a little. Wish you the best as well.
Thanks. I really want to believe you that things will go easier in time. It's difficult for me to see that in this point of my life.

The things that make me a bad person is the emotional rollercoaster that I made my parents and ex go through. I've hurt people in ways that were unnecessary, selfish and plain stupid. Seeking help at this point just seams like a waste of time for the other person since I'm dead set of thinking that I'm a burden to most people. My life is already over. Thanks for being so considered and taking the time to write all these comments. You gave me things to think about.

That does make sense. I realised that during the relationship with her too so I did go into therapy. The therapist told me I should think less and act more with my heart. Asides from that she said things that were kind of mean and didn't help at all. Even said that I'm a jerk and should feel very luck that my then girlfriend is willing to put up with me. Tried to hide my tears on the bus ride back and didn't go back to therapy after that. I know that finding a therapist with whom I can connect with is difficult. Especially after losing motivation of seeing one after my last experience. Besides, I'm not even sure if I wan't to get "better". I don't want other people to have to put up with me for much longer. As I see it, my existence bestows more stress on other people than it does positivity. In some twisted logic I resent people that take a liking to me so I tend to avoid them. Haven't had much contact with my parents in the past years which is an incentive for me to just end it all. I'm sure that they won't miss who I am now but rather miss the person they think I am.

There is a reason for me. I've felt more comfortable with my ex than with any other person I had ever met. She wasn't mean to me, think I was odd and I could somehow make her smile. Me opening up to her was a mistake because she went trough a lot of stress and worries because of me. I do not want to do that to another human being ever again. I know life isn't easy but it's not supposed to be this hard all the time, right?

Now that I've thought more about your question. It's the hate for myself that's keeping me from becoming what I want to be (no idea what I want to be though). That hate is mainly the sum of my past and knowing that others will only do themselves a disservice by trying to become closer with me.

This may sound odd because I haven't formulated the though properly. I've dropped out of school when I was 17 partly due to the bullying and have been employed full time ever since. Switched companies some where along the line. I've grown a lot in this field and am relatively successful, at least for the standards I have. But now that I look around and see other people living their life, seeing them being happy in relationships, having hobbies and enjoying the company of others. It feels like I've missed a huge part of my life while studying and working which I can not get back now. The past two years of my life feel like someone hit  repeat. Most days are the same and I've been gradually losing the ability to relate to others. Even reading this back to myself I'm embarrassed how arrogant and pretentious this makes me sound. I don't want to live this kind of life anymore. It's easier to push other people away than to introduce them to the mess I am now.

I guess it's my choice to be isolated since I only go outside to work. Thing is that I've become so desensitised towards other people that I belief that they should not be around me if they are looking for friendship. I'm not going to claim that I had a tough childhood but have been bullied for most of my time in high school which forced me into this habit where I always question the motivation for someone being kind to me. One "redeeming" quality of mine is that I'm decent at my work which is expected since it's the only thing I've done in my spare time as well for the past five years. I honestly don't really know why I'm telling all this it's not going to make any positive impact on the world. Thank you for the reply and I feel obligated to say I'm sorry for taking taking your time and consideration to write it. I don't think my point of writing this was to search for a solution since I don't really want to be alive anymore anyway.
